Ottawa Mayoral Candidate Charged with Alleged Death Threats

Geoffrey Nicholas Griplas, a registered candidate in Ottawa's mayoral election, has been charged with making alleged death threats against Ottawa Mayor Mark Sutcliffe and Ontario Premier Doug Ford. Griplas is listed as one of 14 mayoral candidates under the name 'Geoff Nicholas'. The specific details of the alleged threats and the timeline of the charges were not provided in the coverage.
